create_app_state_rearrange_v2: create an AppStateRearrangeV2 instance to manage a multiplayer rearrangement HITL session with users and agents
record_frame_state: use FrameRecorder to record agent positions, object states, and user events at each frame
manage_user_data: create a UserData instance to track user-specific UI events, camera transforms, and episode completion status
configure_rearrange_v2_agents: load a RearrangeV2Config from raw config dict to set agent head sensors and object state permissions
update_camera_transform: call AgentData.update_camera_transform to set the agent camera and propagate to head sensors
